decisions.reason: Despite some organisational slack in an expanding firm, a close-to-core product that appears only at launch and not thereafter likely fell short of aspiration levels, so management would reallocate resources to stronger core and development projects.

Because this filter built directly on the established offer, its lack of continued market visibility after launch is a strong sign that performance did not meet aspirations, prompting problemistic search and withdrawal.

For a broad but disciplined German machinery supplier, a newly launched coolant filter that does not remain visibly marketed after the initial period likely underperformed relative to internal and peer aspirations and would be discontinued.
